title: Agri Samaj — Community Platform
overview: An open-source Marathi–English platform built specifically for the Agri Samaj community. It helps people discover local businesses, support community entrepreneurs, access publications and announcements, and stay connected through shared community services.
features: Marathi–English interface with a searchable, approved business directory
Five-step entrepreneur registration with saved drafts and application tracking
Administrative approval workflows, publications, announcements, and inquiries
Private document uploads with authenticated access and server-side role checks
role: Built the bilingual interface, business registration and approval workflows, database models, API routes, private uploads, and administrative tools.
challenges: Separated approved public business information from private application documents while maintaining Marathi–English content, draft persistence, and role-scoped administration.
impact: Brings business discovery, entrepreneur onboarding, publications, and community administration into one open-source platform that contributors can adapt and improve.
